description:
check_xxe_risk reads only 8192 bytes. A crafted XML could place DOCTYPE/entity after the 8KB boundary to bypass detection.

Note: parse_xml uses NONET which provides some protection, but streaming parser path is vulnerable.

Fix: Either parse full stream with safe config, or increase inspection window and document limitation.

comments.text: Reopening context: this was closed on 2026-05-30 but the underlying XXE check still only inspects 8192 bytes. The fix is tracked at fetcherc-zr5.1 (size cap) + fetcherc-zr5.4 (parse_entries also enforces memory limit).

title: XXE check only inspects first 8KB - bypass possible with payload after boundary
